verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm documentation offers full-stack recipes for deploying AI workloads with "popular ROCm-enabled frameworks" and names vLLM and SGLang for inference. The ROCm GPU architecture reference lists the MI325X (CDNA3, gfx942), which ties the card to the documented ROCm stack. However, the evidence never names PyTorch or other mainstream training frameworks and shows no compatibility matrix confirming MI325X support; community doubts about the software stack are general skepticism, not a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: explicit PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX build documentation, a framework support matrix listing MI325X, hands-on corroboration that frameworks run on MI325X.
